source: Beginner short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: جدّتي كبيرة بالعمر بس قلبها شاب.
sentences.en: My grandmother is old but her heart is young.
She tells me stories from long ago.
She knows how to cook many old dishes.
Every day we sit together and talk.
I love my grandmother a lot.
